annotations.title: Search products from Latin American suppliers

description: Search the product catalogue of Latin American suppliers on Paisán. Returns up to 20 products per page with price as listed (or "Request Quote"), minimum order, category, origin and the supplier's id. Every supplier is named. No contact details are included. To contact a supplier, send the buyer to its profileUrl on paisan.net (free to search). Software agents can buy one supplier's contact record through Paisán's paid agent API (/api/agent/v1/suppliers/{id}, see https://paisan.net/openapi.json).

category.description: Optional. Product category exactly as Paisán names it.

country.description: Optional. Country name in English, e.g. "Mexico", "Brazil", "Colombia".

query.description: What the buyer is looking for, in English, Spanish or Portuguese, e.g. "cotton denim fabric".

name: search_products
